def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    bin_loads = np.zeros_like(bins)
    valid_bins = bins > 0
    bin_loads[valid_bins] = (bins[valid_bins] - item) / bins[valid_bins]
    return bin_loads

algorithm: {The algorithm prioritizes bins with the least current utilization, favoring bins that can accommodate the item with minimal waste while balancing load across bins.}
function:
def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - np.minimum(bins, item)
    # Prioritize bins with higher remaining capacity (i.e., more room for the item)
    # Use inverse of remaining capacity to penalize bins that are already full or nearly full
    priorities = 1.0 / (remaining + 1e-8)  # Add small epsilon to avoid division by zero
    return priorities
